name: multisow-crop-system
description: Multi-Tier Crop Management System - Integrated Development Environment

scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run open-browser" --kill-others --names "BACKEND,BROWSER" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold"
scripts.open-browser: npx wait-on http://localhost:8000/health && npx open-cli http://localhost:8000/frontend/home.html
scripts.start:mac: npx concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run open-browser" --kill-others --names "BACKEND,BROWSER" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold"
